QuickPost: Silver.xlsx was a duplicate of Gold. Bronze.xlsx has Plan Name = Silver (exactly 1.04x Gold; Diamond is exactly 0.96x Gold). Silver is therefore included but verified=false; Bronze has no data.
QuickPost: on rows with Type=Additional, the weight column is read as the additional-weight step in kg and the price as the charge per step. Confirm.
QuickPost: RTO rates not provided (assumed equal to forward). COD rule assumed max(fixed, pct x order value).
Shiprocket: hyperlocal/ONDC listings and India Post and Shiprocket Cargo (per-kg freight) were excluded.
QuickPost Shree Maruti 2KG additional-weight prices (2.5 to 17.5 per step) look low against Shree Maruti 3KG (16 to 36). Confirm.
QuickPost: list prices are ex-GST (gst_included=false, confirmed by the business on 2026-11-12); the engine adds GST_RATE.
NimbusPost: enabled on the business's instruction (2026-11-12) with unnamed services; like-for-like by courier is not possible until names are re-captured.
